title: CLR/12/2017 of Rajkumar Vs Mam Chand

paras.text:
CLR No. 12 of 2017
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate for the
revisionist.
Civil Revision No. 11/2016 was
disposed of by this Court by its order
dated 07.12.2016 rendering only one
opportunity to the tenant-respondent to
summon the concerned postman in
order to prove the delivery/non-delivery
of some post, but when such postman
was strived to be served personally
through dasti, it was reported that he
has been retired and living at a
particular place in Dehradun.
Therefore, in these peculiar
changed circumstances one more
opportunity shall be rendered to the
revisionist for making dasti service to
the postman concerned enabling him to
appear in the Court.
With the directions as above, this
revision 12/2017 also stands disposed
of.
I think there is no need to stretch
this revision by directing to serve the
respondent first.
